description: Applies schema.js changes to the database (tgcloud migrate). push never does this. dry_run defaults to true (--dry-run): preview only. Applying (dry_run: false) requires confirm: true. apply "safe" passes --safe (auto-apply safe changes, skip warnings and manual steps). apply "yes" or omitting apply passes --yes (safe changes plus every warning, including .deprecated drops that delete data; manual type changes are still skipped). local: true diffs against the local schema.js instead of the deployed one (--local) and can be combined with either mode. Show the user the preview before applying. Warn when the preview contains a drop.

confirm.description: Required confirm: true to apply migrations, including drops of .deprecated columns and tables

local.description: Diff against local schema.js instead of the deployed schema (--local)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

name: migrate
title: Database migrations
